title: How Reward Gain Imbalance Shapes Ranking: Rethinking Rubric-Based Reward Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24005v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning constructs rewards for aligning large language models with human preferences, typically by equally aggregating continuous scores that a judge assigns to individual criteria. However, scoring heterogeneity across criteria can distort candidate rankings. Existing work has focused on improving judges, learning criterion weights, or refining aggregation, whereas the interaction between scoring heterogeneity and ranking remains insufficiently understood. We formalize this heterogeneity as \emph{reward gain imbalance}: each criterion enters the aggregated reward with its own reward gain, the gap between its expected scores on satisfied and unsatisfied responses. Counterintuitively, our experiments show that removing this imbalance, even with ground-truth labels, lowers ranking accuracy. translated_title: 奖励增益不平衡如何影响排名：重新思考基于量规的奖励聚合
translated_abstract: 基于量规的强化学习通过构建奖励来使大型语言模型与人类偏好对齐，通常的做法是平等地聚合评判者分配给各个准则的连续分数。然而，准则之间的评分异质性可能会扭曲候选排名。现有工作主要集中在改进评判者、学习准则权重或优化聚合方法，而评分异质性与排名之间的相互作用仍未得到充分理解。我们将这种异质形式化为“奖励增益不平衡”：每个准则以其自身的奖励增益进入聚合奖励，即该准则在满足与不满足的响应上的期望分数之间的差距。出人意料的是，我们的实验表明，消除这种不平衡，即使使用真实标签，也会降低排名准确性。为了解释这一现象，我们推导出了任意两个候选之间的奖励差异的精确分解，将其分解为基本满足……
tldr: 该论文将基于量规的奖励聚合中的评分异质形式化为“奖励增益不平衡”概念，并出人意料地发现消除这种不平衡（即使使用真实标签）反而会降低排名准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes scoring heterogeneity in rubric-based reward aggregation as "reward gain imbalance" and counterintuitively finds that removing this imbalance—even with ground-truth labels—actually lowers ranking accuracy.
